channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Analysis finds increased ICE enforcement in 2025 hurt local employment
item.description: Employment declined last year in U.S. cities where ICE arrests rose, according to the Brookings Institution.

item.title: Early voting begins in some states for midterm elections
item.description: In-person early voting has started in Virginia, Minnesota and South Dakota ahead of this year's midterm elections, according to CBS News' Shawna Mizelle.

item.title: Trump to announce all 50 states joining Medicaid drug pricing model
item.description: President Donald Trump is expected to announce that all 50 states will join a program providing most favored nation pricing for certain Medicaid drugs.

item.title: DOJ says ban on selling handguns to young adults under 21 is unconstitutional
item.description: The Justice Department issued a new legal opinion concluding that a federal law barring firearms dealers from selling handguns to people under 21 is unconstitutional.
